WITH latest_run AS (
    SELECT
        scrape_run_id,
        products_count
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs"
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
    ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

run_quality AS (
    SELECT
        r.scrape_run_id,
        r.products_count AS expected_count,
        COUNT(p.scrape_id) AS actual_count,

        COUNT(p.scrape_id) FILTER (
            WHERE p.source_url IS NULL
               OR TRIM(p.source_url) = ''
        ) AS missing_urls,

        COUNT(p.scrape_id)
            - COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(p.source_url), ''))
            AS non_unique_urls

    FROM latest_run r
    LEFT JOIN "solar_prices"."bronze"."panel_scrape_raw" p
        ON r.scrape_run_id = p.scrape_run_id
    GROUP BY
        r.scrape_run_id,
        r.products_count
)

SELECT *
FROM run_quality
WHERE actual_count = 0
   OR expected_count IS NULL
   OR actual_count <> expected_count
   OR missing_urls > 0
   OR non_unique_urls > 0

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT
        p.scrape_id,
        p.scrape_run_id,
        p.title,
        p.price_text,
        p.power_text,
        p.efficiency_text,
        p.bifaciality_text,
        p.source_url,
        p.is_available,
        p.scraped_at
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."panel_scrape_raw" p
    INNER JOIN "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs" r
        ON p.scrape_run_id = r.scrape_run_id
    WHERE r.status = 'SUCCESS'
)

SELECT
    scrape_id,
    scrape_run_id,
    title,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(price_text) ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]{1,2})?$'
        THEN REPLACE(TRIM(price_text), ',', '.')::NUMERIC(12,2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS price_pln,

    CASE
        WHEN TRIM(power_text) ~ '^[0-9]+[[:space:]]*[Ww]?$'
        THEN SUBSTRING(power_text FROM '[0-9]+')::INTEGER
        ELSE NULL
    END AS power_w,

    NULLIF(TRIM(source_url), '') AS source_url,
    is_available,
    scraped_at

FROM source_data

-- Grain: one observation per (scrape_run_id, source_url).
-- Historical prices from successful and completed scrape runs.
WITH observations AS (
    SELECT
        p.scrape_id,
        p.scrape_run_id,
        p.title,
        p.source_url,
        p.price_pln,
        p.power_w,
        p.is_available,
        p.scraped_at,
        r.finished_at AS observed_at
    FROM "solar_prices"."silver"."stg_panels" p
    INNER JOIN "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs" r
      ON p.scrape_run_id = r.scrape_run_id
    WHERE r.status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
      AND p.source_url IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.source_url) <> ''
      AND p.price_pln > 0
      AND p.power_w > 0
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scrape_run_id, source_url
            ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, scrape_id DESC
        ) AS row_in_run
    FROM observations
),
sequenced AS (
    SELECT
        scrape_id, scrape_run_id, title, source_url,
        price_pln, power_w, is_available, scraped_at, observed_at,
        ROUND(price_pln / power_w, 4) AS pln_per_watt,
        LAG(price_pln) OVER (
            PARTITION BY source_url
            ORDER BY observed_at, scrape_id
        ) AS previous_price_pln
    FROM numbered
    WHERE row_in_run = 1
)
SELECT
    *,
    price_pln - previous_price_pln AS price_change_pln,
    ROUND(
        100 * (price_pln - previous_price_pln)
        / NULLIF(previous_price_pln, 0), 2
    ) AS price_change_pct
FROM sequenced

WITH latest_run AS (
    SELECT scrape_run_id
    FROM "solar_prices"."bronze"."scrape_runs"
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
    ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),

latest_panels AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM "solar_prices"."silver"."stg_panels" p
    INNER JOIN latest_run r
        ON p.scrape_run_id = r.scrape_run_id
    WHERE p.price_pln > 0
      AND p.power_w > 0
      AND p.source_url IS NOT NULL
),

deduplicated AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY source_url
            ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, scrape_id DESC
        ) AS product_row
    FROM latest_panels
),

metrics AS (
    SELECT
        scrape_id,
        scrape_run_id,
        title,
        source_url,
        price_pln,
        power_w,
        is_available,
        scraped_at,

        ROUND(
            price_pln / power_w, 4
        ) AS pln_per_watt,

        ROUND(
            power_w / price_pln, 4
        ) AS watt_per_pln,

        CASE
            WHEN price_pln < 200 THEN '<200 zł'
            WHEN price_pln < 300 THEN '200-300 zł'
            WHEN price_pln < 400 THEN '300-400 zł'
            ELSE '400+ zł'
        END AS price_category

    FROM deduplicated
    WHERE product_row = 1
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN is_available THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            pln_per_watt ASC,
            title ASC
    ) AS overall_rank,

    *
FROM metrics

-- Grain: one row per observation_date.
-- Each product contributes at most once per day.
-- Use latest observation of a product that day BEFORE availability filtering.
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        observed_at::date AS observation_date,
        source_url,
        price_pln,
        power_w,
        pln_per_watt,
        is_available,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY observed_at::date, source_url
            ORDER BY observed_at DESC, scrape_id DESC
        ) AS row_of_day
    FROM "solar_prices"."gold"."product_price_history"
),
daily_snapshot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE row_of_day = 1
),
available AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM daily_snapshot
    WHERE is_available IS TRUE
)
SELECT
    observation_date,
    COUNT(*) AS available_panels,
    ROUND(AVG(price_pln), 2) AS avg_price_pln,
    ROUND(AVG(pln_per_watt), 4) AS avg_pln_per_watt,
    ROUND(MIN(pln_per_watt), 4) AS min_pln_per_watt,
    ROUND(MAX(pln_per_watt), 4) AS max_pln_per_watt
FROM available
GROUP BY observation_date
